nav.label: Sections
lang.label: Language
session.gone: This page lost its session, which happens when the agent restarts. Run redundanet open for a new link.
session.open: Open this page with the command below. It prints a link that works once, for two minutes.
hero.protected.title: Your files are protected
hero.protected.sub: Last backup: %s. Everything it covered is stored with other members.
hero.running.title: Backing up now
hero.running.sub: You can keep working or close this page.
hero.attention.title: Your backup needs attention
hero.attention.sub: See what is wrong just below.
hero.waiting.title: The first backup has not run yet
hero.waiting.sub: It starts by itself a few minutes after the agent, or now if you ask.
hero.empty.title: Nothing is backed up yet
hero.empty.sub: Choose a folder on this computer to keep safe.
hero.node.title: This device is part of the network
hero.node.sub: It runs no backup of its own.
issue.waiting.title: You are not a listed member yet
issue.waiting.text: Storage devices accept your backups once the maintainer has signed you into the member list. Send the join request if you have not.
issue.offline.title: No connection to the network
issue.offline.text: This device reaches no hub. Backups resume by themselves when the connection is back.
issue.minversion.title: The network requires version %s
issue.minversion.text: This device runs an older one and is refused until it updates.
issue.expired.title: The member list's signature has expired
issue.expired.text: New devices are refused until the maintainer signs it again. Yours keeps working.
issue.full.title: Your space is used up
issue.full.text: Your allocation of %d GB is full. Keep fewer versions, exclude what you do not need, or ask for more.
issue.unreadable.title: A folder of %s cannot be read
issue.failed.title: The last backup of %s failed
issue.verify.title: The last restore test failed
issue.verify.text: %d of %d sample files were read back.
issue.updatefailed.title: Version %s could not be installed
issue.updatefailed.text: The previous version came back by itself. It is not tried again until you ask.
issue.update.title: Version %s is ready
issue.update.text: It installs by itself within the hour. The old version is kept and comes back if the new one fails.
issue.noservice.title: The agent is not installed as a service
issue.noservice.text: It runs only while this terminal is open. The command redundanet service install starts it at login.
tile.verify.none: No test has run yet. A sample of files is read back every week.
tile.space.partial: Counted on %d of %d storage devices, so this is a minimum.
tile.space.unknown.detail: It is counted at the next backup.
where.title: Where your files are
where.text: Each file is encrypted on this computer, then split into %[1]d pieces kept on other members' storage devices. Any %[2]d of them rebuild it, and nobody but you can read them.
activity.title: Recent activity
activity.backup.partial: Backup of %s stopped before the end. Files stored: %d
activity.verify.passed: Restore test passed: %d of %d sample files read back
activity.verify.failed: Restore test failed: %d of %d sample files read back
backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: The folders this computer keeps safe. Backups run by themselves on the schedule in Settings.
run.never: No backup of this folder has run yet.
fact.partial: stopped before the end; what is listed is stored
set.excludes.label: Leave out, separated by commas
set.excludes.hint: File name patterns such as *.iso, or folders inside the backed up folder such as cache/. Caches and system files are left out already.
set.remove.text: New backups of it stop. The versions already stored stay until they age out, and can still be restored.
add.title: Add a folder
add.name: Name
add.folder: Folder on this computer, as a full path
add.hint: On macOS a folder under Documents, Desktop or Downloads needs Full Disk Access for RedundaNet. If it is missing, the answer says which setting to change.
verify.title: Restore tests
verify.intro: A sample of your files is read back from the network and compared, so you know a restore works before you need one.
network.title: Devices and network
network.intro: Who this device is, and how it reaches the others.
device.title: This device
members.title: Member list
hubs.title: Hubs
peers.title: Connections to other devices
peers.intro: Direct when the two devices can reach each other, through the hub otherwise. Both carry the same encrypted data.
peers.none: No connection to another device yet.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Each section is saved on its own.
schedule.title: Schedule
retention.title: Versions to keep
retention.intro: Older versions are thinned out, never the newest one.
retention.days: Every version, for this many days
retention.daily: Then one a day, for this many days
retention.weekly: Then one a week, for this many weeks
retention.monthly: Then one a month, for this many months
speed.title: Internet speed
speed.intro: In kilobytes per second. 0 means no limit. A change applies at once.
updates.title: Updates
updates.intro: New versions install by themselves within the hour. The old one is kept and comes back if the new one fails.
updates.disabled: updates are off in this build
channel.title: Which releases
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: For when something is wrong, or you are curious.
diag.title: Diagnostics bundle
diag.text: Versions, counts and redacted log lines to send when you ask for help. No file names, no addresses. Nothing is uploaded: the file is saved on this computer.
internals.title: Inside the agent
cleanup.totals: objects kept: %d, deleted: %d, too recent to delete: %d
log.title: Log
msg.noupdates: Updates are off in this build.
msg.apply.started: The update has started. The agent restarts when the new version has proven itself, and this page then needs a new link.
msg.retry.done: Version %s is tried again at the next check.
msg.backup.requested: Backup requested. Progress shows on this page.
msg.verify.requested: Restore test requested. The result shows under Backups.
msg.add.incomplete: A name and a folder are both needed.
msg.add.exists: A folder named %s is backed up already. Choose another name.
msg.add.done: %s is backed up from now on. The first backup starts with the next run, or now if you ask.
msg.setup.written: Identity written. The agent is starting.
msg.setup.restored: Identity restored on this device. The agent is starting.
setup.subtitle: Setting up this device
setup.welcome.text: This device needs an identity before it can back anything up. Everything here stays on this computer: the page is served on 127.0.0.1 only.
setup.new.title: I am new here
setup.new.text: A twelve-word recovery phrase is made for you and shown once. Write it down and keep it like a passport: your member key comes from it, and so does every device you ever add. There is no reset.
setup.phrase.title: I have my recovery phrase
setup.phrase.text: You are a member already and this is a new device. Type the twelve words and this device gets a certificate of its own.
setup.phrase.label: The twelve words, in order
setup.pair.title: Another device of mine is nearby
setup.pair.text: Pair with it: this page shows a code, you run redundanet device pair with that code on the other device, with your phrase, and the phrase never leaves it. The two devices reach each other directly on the same network, or through the hub from anywhere.
setup.words.title: Your recovery phrase
setup.words.once: Shown once. Write these twelve words down, in order, and keep them where you keep your passport. They are the only way back to your data on another machine; nobody can recover them for you.
setup.words.gone: The phrase was shown once, on the page before this one. If you did not write it down, start over: a new phrase is made and nothing has been written yet.
setup.words.check: Now type three of the words back, from what you wrote down:
setup.pairing.title: Pairing
setup.pairing.text: On a device of yours that already has its identity, anywhere, run this with your phrase at hand:
setup.pairing.hint: The code is good for ten minutes and one device. This page refreshes on its own and continues once the other device has answered.
setup.done.title: Identity written
setup.done.text: The agent is starting with it. This page refreshes on its own and shows the device in a moment.
